title: Consumer Matrix + SVI Integration
brief: Register handbook intelligence as an SVI dimension, build the consumer matrix documenting all handbook data flows across pipelines, and verify end-to-end coverage. Machines without ingested handbooks show as knowledge gaps in SVI. Track handbook-sourced improvement in physics accuracy across all consumers.

units.title: Build handbook consumer matrix: document every engine, pipeline, hook, and skill that consumes handbook data with data flow direction, section types consumed, and fallback behavior when handbook is absent

Register handbook coverage as SVI dimension in SystemVariabilityIndexEngine: machines without ingested handbooks contribute to SVI gap score, track per-machine handbook completeness (0-100% across 10 section types)
Build end-to-end integration test: ingest a handbook, verify data flows through physics pipeline, business pipeline, safety pipeline, and appears in SVI report with correct coverage metrics

exit_conditions: Consumer matrix documents all handbook data consumers with section types and fallback behavior
SVI reports handbook coverage per machine and contributes to overall system variability score
End-to-end test proves handbook data flows from ingestion through all consuming pipelines to SVI reporting
Machines without handbooks are visibly flagged as knowledge gaps in SVI dashboard
